result.summary: The screen mostly renders correctly, but the horizontal 'Fastest near you' carousel contains duplicated restaurant entries and clipped text, favourite-button styling is inconsistent between cards, and the last card in 'Popular right now' is cut off by the bottom navigation bar without adequate scroll padding.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards with the same 15–25 min ETA and €0.90 delivery fee, suggesting duplicated data or a rendering key bug.
issues.suggestion: De-duplicate the restaurant list by ID before rendering the carousel, or verify the API response isn't returning the same venue twice.

issues.description: The third carousel item ('Smash Bros Bu…') is hard-clipped at the screen edge, and its title and price text are truncated mid-word without an ellipsis, making the item look broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding/peek so the next card is partially visible in a deliberate way, and apply text truncation with an ellipsis to card titles.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza) is abruptly cut off by the bottom tab bar; its name, rating and metadata row are not visible, so the list appears to end mid-card.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom scroll padding equal to the tab bar height (plus safe area) so the last card can fully scroll into view.

issues.description: Favourite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the Tokumaru card uses a white circular button with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card uses a dark/translucent circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardise the favourite button to a single style (e.g. white circle with dark heart) regardless of image brightness, or apply a consistent scrim behind it.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped at the right edge with only a sliver of the next chip visible, giving no clear affordance that the row scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Show a consistent peek of the next chip or add a fade/gradient edge to indicate horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: The notification bell with a red badge and the heart favourite buttons are icon-only controls with no visible text label, so their purpose and state may not be conveyed to screen readers.
issues.suggestion: Add accessible labels such as 'Notifications, 1 unread' and 'Add to favourites / Remove from favourites' with pressed state.

issues.description: Placeholder-looking flat illustrations are used as restaurant imagery in the carousel, and the same illustration repeats, which reads as unloaded/mock content.
issues.suggestion: Load real venue photos with a neutral skeleton placeholder while images fetch, and vary fallback imagery per cuisine.
